title: [Field Service Integration] Rounding error on Service Line quantity write-back for Item-type service lines with non-divisible durations
summary: Service line quantities synced from Field Service are now properly rounded before validation to prevent precision errors on non-divisible durations.
key_points: Wraps duration-to-hours division with UOMMgt.RoundQty before passing to Quantity validation
Handles both defined and undefined item UoM rounding precision cases
Covers five quantity-conversion sites in estimated and actual paths
Falls back to 0.00001 precision when item precision is not configured
Prevents validation errors on fractional hour quantities like 0.333... from 20-minute durations
quote: Wrap every /60 result with UOMMgt.RoundQty(value, ServiceLine."Qty. Rounding Precision") before passing to Validate.
